items.title: Cloud email and collaboration service: sign-in delays
items.summary: Some users saw delays signing in and syncing mail for about two hours. The provider has confirmed full recovery.
items.action: No action needed. If users still see issues, ask them to sign out and sign in again.

items.title: Code hosting platform: build pipelines delayed
items.summary: Automated build and deployment jobs are starting later than usual. The provider is applying a fix.
items.action: Avoid scheduling urgent releases until the provider reports full recovery.

items.title: Critical flaw in a widely used VPN gateway
items.summary: An unauthenticated attacker could run code on affected devices. The vendor has released fixed versions.
items.action: Apply the vendor patch, restrict admin access to trusted networks and review logs for unusual logins.

items.title: High-severity issue in an open-source web server module
items.summary: Specially crafted requests could expose data from server memory. A fixed release is available.
items.action: Upgrade to the fixed release and restart the service.

items.title: Report cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours
items.summary: Under CERT-In's Directions of 28 April 2022, specified cyber incidents must be reported within 6 hours of noticing them. ICT system logs must be kept for 180 days within India, and system clocks synchronised to NIC or NPL time servers.
items.action: Keep an incident-reporting contact and runbook ready, and check that log retention meets 180 days.

items.title: Use NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 as your checklist
items.summary: CSF 2.0, released in February 2024, adds a sixth function, Govern, to Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover. It applies to organisations of any size.
items.action: Map your current controls to the six functions and fix the biggest gaps first.

items.title: Start planning for post-quantum cryptography
items.summary: NIST published its first post-quantum standards in August 2024: FIPS 203 (ML-KEM), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) and FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA).
items.action: List where you use RSA and ECC, and prioritise systems that protect long-lived data.

items.title: Use phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication
items.summary: NIST digital identity guidelines recommend multi-factor authentication, and phishing-resistant methods for higher-risk access.
items.action: Turn on MFA for all admin, remote and email access, starting with privileged accounts.
